verdict.rationale: GlitchTip supports project-level alert routing (via teams) and basic recipients (email by default, plus adding a webhook URL), which could technically forward to Slack/PagerDuty, but there is no documented support for environment- or severity-based routing, nor per-rule thresholds like frequency spikes or affected-user counts. Missing for 10: environment/severity-based routing rules, native Slack/PagerDuty integrations, configurable thresholds for new-issue/frequency-spike/affected-user-count alerts.
